exposure: Use of highly effective contraceptive method
cohort: Women living with HIV/AIDS (WLWHA) in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, aged 18-49 years, not on menopause, and without tubal ligation
finding: Higher pregnancy incidence was associated with higher CD4 nadir, antiretroviral regimens not containing Efavirenz, and prior teenage pregnancy, while lower incidence was observed in women with higher viral load, older age, more children, and using highly effective contraception.
mod_finding: Study found a high rate of cesarean sections.
